changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Fix indicator labels for authority 400/410/411/430/451 and bibliographic 341
changeSet.sql: WITH field_map AS ( SELECT f.id, f.tag, s.profile FROM field f JOIN specification s ON f.specification_id = s.id WHERE s.family = 'MARC' ) UPDATE indicator i SET label = v.label FROM field_map fm JOIN (VALUES ('AUTHORITY', '400', 2, 'Preferred variant heading'), ('AUTHORITY', '410', 2, 'Preferred variant heading'), ('AUTHORITY', '411', 2, 'Preferred variant heading'), ('AUTHORITY', '430', 1, 'Preferred variant heading'), ('AUTHORITY', '451', 2, 'Preferred variant heading'), ('BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 2, 'Presence of accessibility features/hazards') ) AS v(profile, tag, indicator_order, label) ON fm.tag = v.tag AND fm.profile = v.profile::family_profile_enum WHERE i.field_id = fm.id AND i.indicator_order = v.indicator_order;

changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Fix indicator code labels for authority 400/410/411/430/451 and bibliographic 341
changeSet.sql: WITH field_map AS ( SELECT f.id, f.tag, s.profile FROM field f JOIN specification s ON f.specification_id = s.id WHERE s.family = 'MARC' ), indicator_map AS ( SELECT i.id, fm.tag, fm.profile, i.indicator_order FROM indicator i JOIN field_map fm ON fm.id = i.field_id ) UPDATE indicator_code ic SET label = v.label FROM indicator_map im JOIN (VALUES ('AUTHORITY', '400', 2, '#', 'No information provided'), ('AUTHORITY', '410', 2, '#', 'No information provided'), ('AUTHORITY', '411', 2, '#', 'No information provided'), ('AUTHORITY', '430', 1, '#', 'No information provided'), ('AUTHORITY', '451', 2, '#', 'No information provided'), ('BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 1, '0', 'Accessibility information related to primary content'), ('BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 1, '1', 'Accessibility information related to secondary content'), ('BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 2, '#', 'No information provided') ) AS v(profile, tag, indicator_order, code, label) ON im.tag = v.tag AND im.profile = v.profile::family_profile_enum AND im.indicator_order = v.indicator_order WHERE ic.indicator_id = im.id AND ic.code = v.code;

changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Add new indicator codes for authority 400/410/411/430/451 and bibliographic 341
changeSet.sql: WITH field_map AS ( SELECT f.id, f.tag, s.profile FROM field f JOIN specification s ON f.specification_id = s.id WHERE s.family = 'MARC' ), indicator_map AS ( SELECT i.id, fm.tag, fm.profile, i.indicator_order FROM indicator i JOIN field_map fm ON fm.id = i.field_id ), new_codes (id, profile, tag, indicator_order, code, label) AS ( VALUES ('038726ef-30b6-4d23-b49e-9cd0cf9844d1'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '400', 2, '1', 'Preferred variant heading'), ('49ade901-8ec7-46d2-83ed-2e19a58be5ca'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '410', 2, '1', 'Preferred variant heading'), ('5d423ad9-b8ec-4eee-a155-5cf2ab9cca05'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '411', 2, '1', 'Preferred variant heading'), ('7b1d291d-5a88-4a2a-b975-f392502cedc8'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '430', 1, '1', 'Preferred variant heading'), ('9ce41add-047c-4929-8f26-aea9e0b1a8e9'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '451', 2, '1', 'Preferred variant heading'), ('3ac9e629-4288-421c-b046-4ce24426672c'::uuid, 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 2, '1', 'Accessibility features present'), ('0fe7d491-6550-44a3-bd27-52d8687b9f75'::uuid, 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 2, '2', 'No accessibility features present'), ('c0375243-2d55-4c76-9625-6a9df7831de8'::uuid, 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 2, '3', 'Sensory hazards present') ) INSERT INTO indicator_code (id, created_by_user_id, updated_by_user_id, created_date, updated_date, code, label, deprecated, scope, indicator_id) SELECT nc.id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', now(), now(), nc.code, nc.label, false, 'STANDARD'::scope_enum, im.id FROM new_codes nc JOIN indicator_map im ON im.tag = nc.tag AND im.profile = nc.profile::family_profile_enum AND im.indicator_order = nc.indicator_order ON CONFLICT (code, indicator_id) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Pin the same ids used above into specification_metadata.fields, so a future SpecificationSyncService full resync keeps reusing them instead of generating new ones (see docs/marc-spec-corrections.md). Skipped per-code if an id is already pinned there.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE rec RECORD; BEGIN FOR rec IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('038726ef-30b6-4d23-b49e-9cd0cf9844d1'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '400', 2, '1'), ('49ade901-8ec7-46d2-83ed-2e19a58be5ca'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '410', 2, '1'), ('5d423ad9-b8ec-4eee-a155-5cf2ab9cca05'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '411', 2, '1'), ('7b1d291d-5a88-4a2a-b975-f392502cedc8'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '430', 1, '1'), ('9ce41add-047c-4929-8f26-aea9e0b1a8e9'::uuid, 'AUTHORITY', '451', 2, '1'), ('3ac9e629-4288-421c-b046-4ce24426672c'::uuid, 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 2, '1'), ('0fe7d491-6550-44a3-bd27-52d8687b9f75'::uuid, 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 2, '2'), ('c0375243-2d55-4c76-9625-6a9df7831de8'::uuid, 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 2, '3') ) AS v(id, profile, tag, indicator_order, code) LOOP UPDATE specification_metadata sm SET fields = jsonb_set( sm.fields, ARRAY[rec.tag], COALESCE(sm.fields->rec.tag, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('indicators', COALESCE(sm.fields->rec.tag->'indicators', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(rec.indicator_order::text, COALESCE(sm.fields->rec.tag->'indicators'->rec.indicator_order::text, jsonb_build_object('order', rec.indicator_order)) || jsonb_build_object('codes', COALESCE(sm.fields->rec.tag->'indicators'->rec.indicator_order::text->'codes', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(rec.code, jsonb_build_object( 'id', rec.id::text, 'code', rec.code, 'scope', 'STANDARD', 'defaultValue', false)) ) ) ), true ) FROM specification s WHERE sm.specification_id = s.id AND s.family = 'MARC' AND s.profile = rec.profile::family_profile_enum AND NOT (COALESCE(sm.fields->rec.tag->'indicators'->rec.indicator_order::text->'codes', '{}'::jsonb) ? rec.code); END LOOP; END $$;

changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Fix the label of bibliographic field 041 subfield $a
changeSet.sql: WITH field_map AS ( SELECT f.id, f.tag, s.profile FROM field f JOIN specification s ON f.specification_id = s.id WHERE s.family = 'MARC' ) UPDATE subfield sf SET label = 'Language code of text or sound track' FROM field_map fm WHERE sf.field_id = fm.id AND fm.profile = 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC' AND fm.tag = '041' AND sf.code = 'a';

changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Add subfields $7 and $h to bibliographic field 341
changeSet.sql: WITH field_map AS ( SELECT f.id, f.tag, s.profile FROM field f JOIN specification s ON f.specification_id = s.id WHERE s.family = 'MARC' ), new_subfields (id, tag, profile, code, label, repeatable, required, deprecated, scope) AS ( VALUES ('c93599b3-d267-418c-b8cc-5b1117242c9a'::uuid, '341', 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '7', 'Data provenance', true, false, false, 'STANDARD'), ('c514940b-ffe6-475d-be9d-6daaedc06edb'::uuid, '341', 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', 'h', 'Sensory hazards', true, false, false, 'STANDARD') ) INSERT INTO subfield (id, created_by_user_id, updated_by_user_id, created_date, updated_date, code, label, repeatable, required, deprecated, scope, field_id) SELECT ns.id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', now(), now(), ns.code, ns.label, ns.repeatable, ns.required, ns.deprecated, ns.scope::scope_enum, fm.id FROM new_subfields ns JOIN field_map fm ON fm.tag = ns.tag AND fm.profile = ns.profile::family_profile_enum ON CONFLICT (field_id, code) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: pavlo_smahin
changeSet.comment: Pin the same ids used above into specification_metadata.fields, so a future SpecificationSyncService full resync keeps reusing them instead of generating new ones (see docs/marc-spec-corrections.md). Skipped per-code if an id is already pinned there.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE rec RECORD; BEGIN FOR rec IN SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('c93599b3-d267-418c-b8cc-5b1117242c9a'::uuid, 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', '7'), ('c514940b-ffe6-475d-be9d-6daaedc06edb'::uuid, 'BIBLIOGRAPHIC', '341', 'h') ) AS v(id, profile, tag, code) LOOP UPDATE specification_metadata sm SET fields = jsonb_set( sm.fields, ARRAY[rec.tag], COALESCE(sm.fields->rec.tag, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('subfields', COALESCE(sm.fields->rec.tag->'subfields', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(rec.code, jsonb_build_object( 'id', rec.id::text, 'code', rec.code, 'scope', 'STANDARD', 'defaultValue', false)) ), true ) FROM specification s WHERE sm.specification_id = s.id AND s.family = 'MARC' AND s.profile = rec.profile::family_profile_enum AND NOT (COALESCE(sm.fields->rec.tag->'subfields', '{}'::jsonb) ? rec.code); END LOOP; END $$;
